      "observations": [
        "The account server first synchronizes folder hierarchy, then calls the requested folder message sync. A root-folder request and PerformBiff instead start sync for all descendants. Folder GetNewMessages and UpdateFolder share the message-sync helper, leaving hierarchy refresh in UpdateFolder deferred.",
        "The reviewer first accepted a current-folder design, then reported messages still not updating. Author identified the missed account-root route and applied whole-account sync. The nonblocking early-return concern was addressed by logging each immediate folder failure and continuing the loop. This starts operations; returning NS_OK does not mean every message download completed.",
        "The Rust hierarchy routine invokes OnSuccess after processing all response pages, which triggers the continuation. Broader listener architecture and a folder queue remain follow-ups. Fake SyncFolderItems returns empty changes, and the added TODO explicitly does not assert message population; folder membership assertions do not cover whole-account message results.",
        "The first landing was backed out for bustage. The missing-upstream-dependency explanation was disputed, and author identified accidental temporary local Cargo changes. Eight owned reland postimages are identical to the original; generated lock content is excluded from authored behavior. A rebase then missed two delete-test calls, fixed in2605.",
        "Fixed source preserves the routing and nonfatal per-folder immediate-error logging but has later moved classes, listener management, invalidated-folder handling and hierarchy-error continuation. Those later paths are current source evidence, not claims about the initial landing."
